nodes.description: receive() external payable fallback that accepts plain Ether transfers and holds funds in the contract.
external bait(address) function that delegatecalls into an attacker-supplied contract address and requires success.
attacker-controlled address parameter of bait(address), used both as the delegatecall target and as the call argument.
boolean local variable capturing the return status of the delegatecall.
Low-level _pickpocket.delegatecall(abi.encodeWithSignature("finesse(address)", _pickpocket)) executing untrusted code in the context of Bait and exposing its storage/funds.

edges.reason: bait() consumes the externally supplied address _pickpocket as its only input with no validation or allowlist.
bait() unconditionally transfers execution to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Attacker-controlled _pickpocket is used directly as the delegatecall target, so arbitrary external code runs in Bait's storage context (arbitrary delegatecall).
The delegatecall return status is assigned to the success local variable and checked by require.
The delegatecall into untrusted code can re-enter Bait, including its payable receive() function holding Ether, before bait() completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is a pure data dependency whose only semantic role is to feed the attacker-controlled delegatecall target, so it should be normalized into the unsafe_operation node.
The local variable merely stores the delegatecall result flag and carries no independent semantics, so it should be merged into the unsafe_operation that produces it.
